storyTitle: Councillor's corridor care testimony highlights failings at Queen's Hospital
headline: Councillor exposes corridor care crisis at Queen's Hospital
committee: Health Scrutiny Committee Barking and Dagenham, 21 October 2026

watchability.targetAudience: Barking and Dagenham residents and local taxpayers
watchability.hook: Councillor exposes corridor care crisis at Queen's Hospital
watchability.hookStyle: Immediate factual council decision and resident impact
watchability.localRelevance: Directly affects Barking and Dagenham residents and council services

claims.statement: Councillor Marion Hull suffered severe pain and delays in a corridor after breaking her hip.
claims.sourceQuote: Councillor Hull described excruciating pain, prolonged waits for pain relief and a catheter, and a lack of privacy while being treated in a busy corridor following a fall that resulted in a broken hip and wrist.
claims.sourceDocument: Health Scrutiny Committee Barking and Dagenham, 21 October 2026

claims.statement: Queen's Hospital A&E routinely handles more than double its intended capacity.
claims.sourceQuote: Queen's Hospital's A&E department was built for 300 or so patients a day, and we've been receiving, on many occasions, more than twice that number of patients.
claims.sourceDocument: Health Scrutiny Committee Barking and Dagenham, 21 October 2026

claims.statement: The hospital trust secured forty-two million pounds to rebuild the emergency department.
claims.sourceQuote: A significant step is the secured funding of £42 million to rebuild the A&E department, with construction expected to begin in the coming months.
claims.sourceDocument: Health Scrutiny Committee Barking and Dagenham, 21 October 2026

takeawayCard.title: Seven In Ten Patients Diverted
takeawayCard.subtitle: Walk-in cases are diverted to urgent clinics.

keyPoints: The department was built for 300 patients but often sees double.
Corridor patients dropped twenty-five per cent from 6,274 to 4,681.
Secured funding of £42 million will rebuild Queen's hospital emergency department.
